output.reason: [ev-23e99dfde8d0] limits the fix to AWS Route53 not-found errors raised while DNS records are being deleted. Using Route53 for DNS-01 (an Issuer or ClusterIssuer with a route53 solver) is needed for exposure, but it is not enough. The changed behaviour only shows up when Route53 actually returns a not-found error during deletion, and no configuration records that. So the proposed config-only condition is too broad, and it needs an undecidable runtime operand added to it.

correction.statement: Environments are exposed when an Issuer or ClusterIssuer uses an ACME DNS-01 solver backed by AWS Route53 and Route53 returns a not-found error while cert-manager deletes a DNS record at runtime. In that case cert-manager 1.18.0 now detects the not-found error correctly.

of.needed: whether AWS Route53 returns not-found errors when cert-manager deletes DNS-01 challenge records at runtime
